mapper.select: SELECT BANNER_ID, TITLE, LINK_URL, POSITION, START_YMD, END_YMD, USE_YN, ORDR, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, REGIST_DT FROM BANNER WHERE BANNER_ID = #{bannerId}

SELECT BANNER_ID, TITLE, LINK_URL, ATCH_FILE_GRPID FROM BANNER WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND POSITION = #{position} AND START_YMD <= REPLACE(CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND END_YMD >= REPLACE(CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') ORDER BY ORDR, REGIST_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BANNER ( BANNER_ID, TITLE, LINK_URL, POSITION, START_YMD, END_YMD, USE_YN, ORDR, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{bannerId}, #{title}, #{linkUrl}, #{position}, #{startYmd}, #{endYmd}, #{useYn}, #{ordr}, #{atchFileGrpid}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BANNER SET TITLE = #{title}, LINK_URL = #{linkUrl}, POSITION = #{position}, START_YMD = #{startYmd}, END_YMD = #{endYmd}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, ORDR = #{ordr}, ATCH_FILE_GRPID = #{atchFileGrpid}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE BANNER_ID = #{bannerId}
